headline: Start Brissett over Hurts. Inactives at 8:30 AM decide Jefferson (ankle) and McLaurin (hamstring), so check the app before the 10 AM games lock.
alerts: 6:30 AM: Eagles at Jaguars in London kicks off and locks Hurts. Bench him for Brissett before then.
8:30 AM: inactives for the 10 AM games. If Jefferson is out, start Hockenson in his place. McLaurin is a lean to play, with Diggs already out.
Lamar Jackson is officially out for the Ravens on Sunday night, which helps Brian Robinson's game script.

PHI.note: London game at 6:30 AM Pacific. Long trip and an early lock before late injury news.

BAL.note: Lamar Jackson is out. Backup quarterback starts.

ATL.note: Sunday night game, 5:20 PM Pacific. Ravens are without Lamar Jackson.

DAL.note: Played Thursday night. Points are final.

TB.note: Played Thursday night. Points are final.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: Lions are favored by about 5 with a 54.5 total, so Arizona projects for roughly 24 to 25 points, 7 or 8 more than the Eagles.
Trailing script should keep him throwing. Dimers projects about 265 passing yards.
Late afternoon kickoff, so you keep all the morning news before he locks.

6904.name: Jalen Hurts
notes: Eagles are 7.5-point underdogs with a 41.5 total, about 17 implied points.
Props: about 190 passing yards, 26.5 rushing yards, and roughly a one-in-three chance at a rushing TD.
London trip and a 6:30 AM Pacific lock, before the late injury news.

sources.title: Inquirer: Eagles vs. Jaguars odds and props

8154.name: Brian Robinson
notes: Steady No. 2 back behind Bijan Robinson with goal-line work: 4 TDs over the last two games.
Falcons are 3-point favorites, and the Ravens are without Lamar Jackson, so a lead and late carries are likely.
Touchdown dependent. He catches very few passes.

9511.name: Keaton Mitchell
notes: Led the Chargers backfield in Week 4: 10 carries plus 6 targets, ahead of Omarion Hampton.
Still a three-way committee with Hampton and Kimani Vidal, and the Chargers project for only about 19 points against Denver.
Coin flip with Lloyd. Mitchell gets the slight edge on passing-game work.

11581.name: MarShawn Lloyd
notes: Lead back only because Josh Jacobs is on the exempt list, but averaging 2.7 yards per carry with no game over 10 points.
Split carries with Kaleb Johnson last week (7 to 8), though he caught 5 passes.

sources.title: Yardbarker: Lloyd is now a stash

7547.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
notes: Lions project for about 30 points, tied for the highest team total of the week.

6794.name: Justin Jefferson
notes: Ankle injury. Missed Week 4, limited in practice Thursday and Friday, listed Questionable.
Start him if active. Inactives post at 8:30 AM Pacific, and the game locks at 10 AM.
If he is out, Hockenson becomes the best replacement.

5844.name: T.J. Hockenson
notes: Caught all 13 targets for 119 yards in Week 4 with Jefferson out.
Bench if Jefferson plays. Start in the FLEX if Jefferson is ruled out.

5927.name: Terry McLaurin
notes: Hamstring. Missed Week 4, limited Friday, and a game-time decision with a slight lean to play.
With Stefon Diggs out, he would be the No. 1 receiver against the Giants if active.
Hamstring reinjury risk is real, so treat him as a backup plan if Jefferson sits.

12501.name: Matthew Golden
notes: Seven targets and a TD in Week 4, his second straight game with a score. Packers project for about 21.5 points against Chicago.

sources.title: NBC Sports: Golden scores in Week 4

9500.name: Josh Downs
notes: Healthy, with no injury tag. Colts at Steelers, with Pittsburgh favored by 2.5 and a 43.5 total.

8110.name: Jake Ferguson
notes: Played Thursday night, so his points are already locked in.

NYJ.name: Jets DEF
notes: Jets are 2.5-point home favorites over Cleveland with a 39.5 total, holding the Browns to about 18.5 implied points.

8155.name: Breece Hall
notes: Listed Out on Sleeper this week.

comparisons.why: Arizona projects for about 25 points to Philadelphia's 17, and Hurts locks early from London.
Robinson has steady goal-line work in a favored offense facing a Ravens team without Lamar. Lloyd is splitting carries at 2.7 yards per carry.
Near coin flip. Mitchell's 6 targets last week give him a slightly better PPR floor.
Jefferson if active. If he is ruled out at 8:30 AM, Hockenson takes his spot after a 13-catch game without him.
